title: Oozy Peruvian Cod Salad
description: Spicy, juicy, light Peruvian dish featuring flaked cod, lime, cilantro, and scallop shells.
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a gentle boil, add a pinch of sea salt.
Add the cod fillet and poach for 4 minutes until firm and opaque.
Remove the cod, let it cool slightly, then flake into small pieces.
In a bowl, combine the flaked cod, diced red onion, chopped cilantro, and freshly ground black pepper.
Juice the limes over the mixture and gently stir.
Drizzle the olive oil and stir until all ingredients are evenly coated.
Season with sea salt to taste and mix again.
Gently warm the scallop shells in a skillet for 1 minute to make them more pliable.
Spoon the salad into each scallop shell, serve immediately.
